name: r4-complex-dag-demo
description: R4 demo workflow with parallel analysis branches and fan-in synthesis.

sample_id.description: Sample the brief is about (free text, e.g. an ID from your notebook).

question.description: The research question the review should answer.

config.system_prompt: You are preparing a concise research workflow context.
config.prompt_template: Create a compact context brief for project {{ params.project_id }}. Sample: {{ params.sample_id }}. Question: {{ params.question }}.

config.system_prompt: You review methods and reproducibility concerns.
config.prompt_template: From this context, extract methods, inputs, assumptions, and reproducibility checks: {{ steps.collect_context.response_text }}

config.system_prompt: You identify operational and data risks for HPC workflow execution.
config.prompt_template: From this context, list risks, missing inputs, and validation gates: {{ steps.collect_context.response_text }}

config.system_prompt: You merge two independent analyses into one balanced plan.
config.prompt_template:
Merge the method review and risk review into a single execution plan. Methods: {{ steps.methods_review.response_text }}
Risks: {{ steps.risk_review.response_text }}

config.system_prompt: Return a short JSON report for the R4 workflow demo.
config.prompt_template: Create a final JSON report with report, next_actions, and confidence from this merged plan: {{ steps.merge_findings.response_text }}
